name: Krusch Skylight Calendar MCP
description: Skylight Calendar 2 stdio MCP connector (@krusch/companion-skylight-connector v0.3.0) with opt-in dry-run staging via dryRun: true (writes are live otherwise) and local twin cache support. Status inspection inherits Guard policy; event listing and chore pulls can write local state when writeBack: true, so they require review. Event creation, chore assignment, list pushes, meal planning, Sidekick Magic Import, task sync, and unified skylight_calendar calls also require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Pass dryRun: true on mutating Skylight tools to preview proposed family calendar, chore, list, and meal changes before they are pushed to Skylight Cloud; calls without it write live.
Use skylight_status and skylight_list_meals for inspection without local writes; keep skylight_list_events and skylight_pull_chores on Review unless writeBack is disabled upstream.
